d:
Paul Bedard, Jimmy Riffle and Ashley Lawrence are taking on some of the biggest alligators in Florida and Mississippi. From backyard intruders to aggressive nuisance gators, the Gator Boys are stepping into dangerous situations to catch and relocate these powerful reptiles.
Watch Gator Boys, Season 1, Episodes 3, 5 & 6, and Season 1C, Episodes 1, 3, 5, 7 & 8 on Animal Planet India.
